seed.rule: rho_seed = max(rho_canonical, 1e-3) on the 2-cell dilation of the body mask (rho>0.05); other cells keep rho_canonical
seed.why: keeps the physical regime close to the original body while giving the bracket a feasible interior neighbourhood

bracket.epsilon_backoff: registered max epsilon; backoff x2 down to epsilon/1024 before rejecting

acceptance: controller merit decrease + volume/constraints + real trial primal + Path B bracket; low trust ratio shrinks the next move but does not veto (Path B profile, trust_veto=false); no magnitude correction
stop_conditions: a proposal that cannot form a symmetric centered pair is rejected, never clipped
no magnitude correction of the adjoint
supersedes: v4 (bound margin 1e-4 on both sides: a centered bracket needs every perturbed cell epsilon away from both bounds)

acceptance_profile.reason: Path B: adjoint magnitude is not trusted

proposal_rule: projected gradient; direction components are zeroed on every cell within the registered bound margin 1e-4 of either bound, independent of sign
